file_info.description: Mode 3: Create standardized master face image from a user portrait

prompts.Command: Generate an ultra-sharp, high-fidelity master identity portrait of the person in [PERSON_IMG].

Identity & Style Consistency: PERFECT LIKENESS: Match the facial geometry of [PERSON_IMG] with 100% fidelity.
HAIRSTYLE: Replicate the exact hair flow and volume. Ensure the hair is not cropped at the top.
STRICT NO-ACCESSORIES: Remove glasses, earrings, necklaces, and hats.
Strict Clothing Change: MANDATORY CLOTHING: Replace any clothing in [PERSON_IMG] with a plain, neutral-colored crew-neck t-shirt.
FORBIDDEN: Strictly NO coats, NO jackets, NO hoodies, NO collars, NO buttons, and NO zippers.
The clothing must appear as a simple, thin fabric neckline visible only at the very bottom edge of the frame.
Aggressive Framing & Zoom: TIGHT CROP: The image must be cropped strictly at the base of the neck/collarbone.
FACE DOMINANCE: The face must occupy 85% of the vertical frame. Minimize all non-facial space.
No chest or torso should be visible.
Pose & Environment: STRICT FRONT-FACING: 0-degree rotation, both ears equally visible, eye-level angle.
BACKGROUND: Solid, flat light grey (#D3D3D3) with zero texture or depth.
LIGHTING: High-key studio lighting, no shadows under the chin.
Technical Specs: 8k, photorealistic, sharp focus on pupils, visible skin texture, zero AI-smoothing.
